subject: planner/core: disable new join reorder when DP is enabled (#67079)
summary: Reviewed the single-hunk change in `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder.go`: the advanced join reorder path (`joinorder.Optimize`) now only runs when `TiDBOptEnableAdvancedJoinReorder` is true and `TiDBOptJoinReorderThreshold <= 0`, otherwise the legacy join reorder (which can use DP when threshold > 0) is used. This matches existing code reality that the new framework currently hardcodes greedy and has DP explicitly TODO/unimplemented, so the guard prevents silently ignoring the DP-enabled configuration. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, session behavior, or planner stability from this gate.
